artifacts.notes: Extent as retrieved and measured: complete uncorrected OCR of Migne, Patrologia Latina vol. 172 (Honorius Augustodunensis and others; Paris: Garnier, 1895), whole volume, 115,977 LF-terminated lines. The volume's own Elenchus, at lines 430-515, lists every work it prints; the containment inventory enters them. Gemma animae stands at lines 42628-58295. Uncorrected optical recognition: a locating and searching layer, not a text of record; column figures and chapter numbers in it are damaged in places, and a reading quoted from it is collated against a page image before it is relied on.
artifacts.rights_basis: The printing reproduced here was published at Paris in 1895, before 1931, and is in the public domain in the United States: the repository's own rights reading, recorded at guidance/missals.md section 5 against Cornell's public-domain chart current at 1 January 2026, is that a work first published abroad before 1931 is in the public domain with no term running. The Internet Archive's optical character recognition of a public-domain printing is a mechanical transcription that adds no original authorship, is served without a copyright claim asserted over it, and carries none of the host's markup, navigation or apparatus; a search of the whole file finds no 'Google' and no 'usage guidelines' string. The bytes are retained because guidance/sources.md makes retention the project-wide default and none of its three exemptions reaches this file: it may lawfully be republished, it is not restricted, and at 4.17 MB it is well within what this library already retains.
